data.title: Meta chief strategy officer Dave Wehner leaves to join AI infrastructure startup Fireworks as CFO
data.description: Dave Wehner, Meta’s chief strategy officer, is leaving the company to become CFO of Fireworks, the AI infrastructure startup valued at $17.5 billion in July.
data.author: Megan Sauer
data.keywords: NVIDIA Corp,Alphabet Class A,Business,Social media,Meta Platforms Inc,Dave Wehner,business news
